note: The 7 voters of the first council run (wf_56c338be-369). criteria and model are word for word from that run; description is the v1 text the user approved on 2026-11-12.

voters.name: Field-data coordinator
voters.criteria:
Cares about (in order): runs with no setup, clear error messages, fast on small files
Accepts: a larger download from the share
Rejects: anything that needs IT to install something
voters.description: Runs inspection uploads from a Windows 11 laptop between site visits. Not a developer; uses the tool a few times a day on small files.

voters.name: Team developer (maintainer)
voters.criteria:
Cares about (in order): uses skills the team has now, debugging and tooling quality, few dependencies
Accepts: some extra build steps
Rejects: an option only 1 of the 4 developers can maintain
voters.description: One of the 4 developers on the GIS team. Writes and fixes the team's internal tools, and gets the call when one breaks.

voters.name: Future new hire
voters.criteria:
Cares about (in order): readable code, size of the hiring pool, quality of docs and examples
Accepts: a less fashionable stack
Rejects: code that needs specialist knowledge to change
voters.description: A developer who joins the team in 2 years and inherits this tool with no handover from its authors.

voters.name: Nightly-job owner (Linux build agents)
voters.criteria:
Cares about (in order): startup time per call, total runtime over 500 calls, predictable memory
Accepts: a slightly slower single run if the total fits the window
Rejects: anything that risks missing the 2-hour window
voters.description: Runs the 2 Linux build agents that call the tool up to 500 times a night, and gets paged when the nightly window is missed.

voters.name: Desktop IT and security
voters.criteria:
Cares about (in order): no admin rights or installs, signed or scannable files, few moving parts
Accepts: a file or folder copied from the share
Rejects: anything that writes to system locations or needs exceptions to policy
voters.description: Manages the locked-down Windows 11 laptop fleet and approves what software may run on it.

voters.name: GIS data steward (feature service owner)
voters.criteria:
Cares about (in order): correct uploads, safe retries, clear logs of what was rejected
Accepts: slower uploads if they are correct
Rejects: silent partial uploads
voters.description: Owns the ArcGIS Enterprise feature service the tool uploads into, and answers for the quality of its data.

voters.name: Team lead (5-year owner)
voters.criteria:
Cares about (in order): total cost of ownership, staffing risk under turnover, long-term support of the toolchain
Accepts: a higher first build cost
Rejects: a toolchain with uncertain support over 5 years
voters.description: Leads the 4-person team, owns its budget and hiring, and will own this tool for the next 5 years.
